$comment: Single source for thesis judgments. Append a new assessment for each review; never edit a published one. Pages render it with <!-- thesis:cards|sections|table [assessment-id] -->; without an id, the latest assessment is used.

basis.zh: 专刊 001 定性编辑判断

interpretation.en: Regional displacement; global structural decline unproved
interpretation.zh: 区域替代成立；全球结构性下降未证实

direction.en: Mixed: EU supports; global fossil growth contradicts near-term displacement
direction.zh: 混合：欧盟支持；全球化石增长不支持近期替代

confidence.zh: 对持续全球替代：低至中等

evidence.en: EU fossil generation fell 8.37% in 2024; global clean share rose [EI-E000164, EI-E000118]
evidence.zh: 欧盟 2024 年化石发电下降 8.37%；全球清洁份额上升 [EI-E000164, EI-E000118]

limits.en: Global fossil generation rose 1.69%; CGR remained 0.760 [EI-E000120, EI-E000121]
limits.zh: 全球化石发电增长 1.69%；CGR 仍为 0.760 [EI-E000120, EI-E000121]

change.en: Consecutive comparable periods of clean growth covering supply growth, accompanied by absolute fossil decline
change.zh: 连续可比时期内，清洁增量覆盖供给增量，同时化石发电绝对下降

interpretation.en: Enabling deployment exists; the dispatchable-service mechanism is untested
interpretation.zh: 支撑性部署已出现；可调度服务机制尚未检验

direction.zh: 支持输入条件；系统效果未决

evidence.en: US 2025 commissioned operating cohort: 46.787 GWh nameplate; stationary-pack benchmark $70/kWh [EI-E000812, EI-E000822]
evidence.zh: 美国 2025 年投运且年末运行的群组：46.787 GWh 铭牌能量；固定式电池包基准 $70/kWh [EI-E000812, EI-E000822]

limits.en: No matched solar charging, peak discharge, gas marginal-hours or K08 service-cost comparison
limits.zh: 缺少匹配的光伏充电、峰时放电、燃气边际定价时数或 K08 服务成本比较

change.en: Metered solar-to-storage dispatch and a matched-service comparison with gas
change.zh: 实测光伏至储能调度，以及与燃气的同等服务比较

interpretation.en: Strengthening in passenger-car sales; broader substitution incomplete
interpretation.zh: 乘用车销售增强；更广泛替代尚未完成

direction.en: Positive in transport; unresolved across all end uses
direction.zh: 交通方向积极；全部终端用途仍未决

confidence.en: Medium–high for car adoption; low–medium for broad fossil substitution
confidence.zh: 汽车采用：中等至高；广泛化石替代：低至中等

evidence.en: EU sales comparison is candidate evidence; global 25% is a validated reported statistic [EI-P4-E010–011, EI-E000814]
evidence.zh: 欧盟销售比较仍为候选；全球 25% 是已验证报告统计 [EI-P4-E010–011, EI-E000814]

limits.en: Sales are not fleet use; EU electricity share of final energy moved only from 23.09% to 23.45% [EI-E000605, EI-E000608]
limits.zh: 销售不等于车队使用；欧盟终端能源中电力份额仅从 23.09% 升至 23.45% [EI-E000605, EI-E000608]

change.en: Fleet use and direct-fossil consumption moving consistently with sales adoption
change.zh: 车队使用与直接化石消耗的变化持续对应销售采用

interpretation.en: A concrete implementation case; general economics and geography unproved
interpretation.zh: 有具体实施案例；普遍经济性与地理变化未证实

direction.zh: 狭义支持；经济效果未决

confidence.en: Very low–low for a demonstrated broad economic shift
confidence.zh: 对已证明的广泛经济转变：极低至低

evidence.en: Rondo's company-reported operating case; lower EU electricity reference [EI-E000824, EI-E000612]
evidence.zh: Rondo 企业报告的运行案例；欧盟电价参考下降 [EI-E000824, EI-E000612]

limits.en: No metered useful-output costs, utilization or matched gas comparator; the EU tariff is not the US site's tariff
limits.zh: 缺少实测有用产出成本、利用率及匹配气价；欧盟电价不是该美国现场的电价

change.en: Commercial operating records showing sustained matched-service cost advantage
change.zh: 商业运行记录显示持续的同等服务成本优势

interpretation.en: Credible constraint watch; increasing dominance not established
interpretation.zh: 值得关注的约束；其主导性增强未成立

direction.zh: 支持瓶颈关注；趋势未决

limits.en: No aligned industrial-load connection or delivered-equipment cohorts; cannot rank constraints
limits.zh: 缺少口径一致的工业负荷接入及设备交付群组，无法排列约束重要性

change.en: Cause-coded connection delays and realized equipment delivery times across comparable cohorts
change.zh: 可比群组中按原因分类的接入延迟与实际设备交付时间

interpretation.en: One concrete component/material link; broader strategic consequences unproved
interpretation.zh: 有具体组件／材料联系；更广泛战略影响未证实

evidence.en: Thermal-storage case identifies brick and wire [EI-E000827]
evidence.zh: 储热案例指明砖和金属丝 [EI-E000827]

limits.en: No qualified grade, material intensity, specification change or substitution series
limits.zh: 缺少认证牌号、材料强度、规格变化或替代序列

change.en: Component specifications, failure data and bills of materials establishing an actual change in requirements
change.zh: 组件规格、失效数据与材料清单证明要求实际改变
